text: My steak was close to $30 alone. For a place that bills itself as a wine bar, I was disappointed with the by-the-glass choices. I guess if you are only searching for a good-tasting steak and you don't know how to cook, Fleming's is the place to go. I guess that's what you get with the "lowest common denominator" style of big national chains. I would not steer most people away from here, as I think this is what most people want: predictable and decent.
